name: 19_vr_differs
title: Same tag with a different VR
description: StudyDescription has the same value in both files but is encoded as LO in A and SH in B.
symptom: Strict validators reject the object; receivers that size fields from the VR truncate the value (SH allows 16 characters, LO 64).

warnings.message_contains: exceeds the maximum length of 16 allowed for VR SH
